docs.text:
Iktomi the spider trickster, the Dakota storytelling at the fireside and tales of the people and animals, retold by a Yankton Dakota writer.

Zitkala-Ša (Gertrude Simmons Bonnin, 1876–1938), Old Indian Legends, Boston, Ginn and Company, 1901. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
